body: Dropped the PROCESS_VERSION edit: upstream AGENTS.md (PV 76) has the merging session bump it. The PR body now says `Process change: yes`. The only change since the reviewed head is that one file, restored to main's value (MECHANICAL).

<!-- pr-reviewer: a09aef1cd57e1c0abf1083595b27f66f2ec9fe6f -->
Needs changes before merge.

What looks good:
- The inside jaws use a circumscribed arc. The stepped jaws include the steel under the work.
- The collision tests block posting when the holder hits the jaws. The clear-holder cases post successfully.
- The new fields have serde defaults. The old-file test passes.
- The UI and MCP use the existing undoable accessory commands.
- The PR leaves PROCESS_VERSION unchanged and states `Process change: yes`. This meets the current upstream rule.

Local results:
The PR merged cleanly with upstream/main at a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504. All commands ran locally on Linux. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 3 steps passed, 0 failed.
- Sim: library 166 passed; lathe_chuck 6 passed; lathe_chuck_jaws 6 passed.
- App: library 340 passed, 1 ignored; nine mapped suites passed, 33 tests total.
- UI: library 861 passed, 6 ignored; thirteen mapped suites passed, 115 tests total, 1 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from crates/ui: 861 passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety mutation checks:
1. Changed the inside arc radius from `r / cos(step/2)` to `r * cos(step/2)`. `inside_grip_envelope_is_pinned` failed at lathe_chuck_jaws.rs:130: `steel at the grip`.
2. Removed the outside step's inward extension, from `r0 - sd` to `r0`. `outside_stepped_jaw_envelope_is_pinned` failed at lathe_chuck_jaws.rs:94: `the step's inner face`.

Each mutation failed its test as expected. I restored the source and ran the complete lathe_chuck_jaws suite: 6 passed, 0 failed. No mutation remains.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fixture_accessory_dialog.rs:138`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the changed dialog and chuck viewport. The body states that no screenshots were taken. Issue #1468 also requests viewport verification. Show the fit controls, inside grip and stepped jaws. Store the screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit review images or evidence to the PR branch.

Notes:
- No golden file or snapshot PNG changed. There are no moved goldens to check.
- Pixel snapshots and the GUI were not run. Windows and macOS were not tested in this review.
- The missing screenshots require `needs-rework`. I will return this mkinney PR to draft for the evidence update.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review requests before/after screenshots for the dialog and chuck viewport.

The PR body now links six images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
They show the old dialog, the fit controls, inside grip, plain jaws, and stepped jaws.
The images use the shipping shell and GPU viewport renderer in an offscreen harness on Linux.

The after images use reviewed head a09aef1cd57e1c0abf1083595b27f66f2ec9fe6f.

The evidence check requires all six valid images and distinct before/after renders.
Removing a required image makes the check fail. Restoring it makes the check pass.
The body link check also fails when a required link is removed and passes after restoration.
No product code, golden image, or capture harness changed on the PR branch.

Quick gate: passed. Clippy for sim, app, and UI: passed.
Head: a09aef1cd57e1c0abf1083595b27f66f2ec9fe6f.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains in this PR.

The later evidence comment permits this review of the same head. I withdraw the earlier screenshot request from this account.

Evidence check:
- All six images in the PR body load. I inspected each image.
- The before/after dialog images show the fit control and step fields. The inside-grip image shows the disabled fit and its explanation.
- The viewport images show the plain jaws, inside jaws, and steps under the work.
- Image commit `2e69f0e90de3f4167d402c576a7c8e75b7d389b0` contains only the six images. It belongs to the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
- The PR changes no image, snapshot PNG, or golden file. There are no moved goldens to check.

What looks good:
- The inside arc contains the true jaw envelope. The steps include the steel under the work.
- The collision tests block the post when the holder hits the jaws. The clear-holder cases post successfully.
- Invalid figures receive named refusals. Old files read the new fields through serde defaults.
- The UI and MCP use the existing undoable accessory commands.
- The body states `Process change: yes`. The PR leaves PROCESS_VERSION unchanged, as current upstream AGENTS.md requires.

Local results:
The trial merge with upstream/main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6` was clean. All commands ran locally on Linux. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; three mapped steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: three steps passed, zero failed.
- Sim: library 166 passed; two chuck suites, 12 passed.
- App: library 340 passed, 1 ignored; nine mapped suites, 33 passed.
- UI: library 895 passed, 6 ignored; thirteen mapped suites, 116 passed, 1 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from crates/ui: 895 passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on unchanged upstream code:

```text
error: constant `MIN_LABEL_PX` is never used
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115:11
115 | pub const MIN_LABEL_PX: f32 = 10.0;
    = note: `-D dead-code` implied by `-D warnings`
error: could not compile `camcraft-ui` (lib) due to 1 previous error
```

That constant and its surrounding code are identical in upstream/main. PR #2083 does not change that file. This is an upstream limitation, not a new PR finding. The full strict clippy check is not green.

Safety mutation checks:
1. Changed the inside arc from `r / cos(step/2)` to `r * cos(step/2)`. `inside_grip_envelope_is_pinned` failed at `lathe_chuck_jaws.rs:130`: `steel at the grip`.
2. Changed the outside step from `r0 - sd` to `r0`. `outside_stepped_jaw_envelope_is_pinned` failed at `lathe_chuck_jaws.rs:94`: `the step's inner face`.

Both mutations failed as expected. The source was restored byte for byte. The complete jaw suite then passed all six tests. The worktree has no source change.

Requested before merge: none.

The images use an offscreen harness. The native GUI, pixel snapshots, Windows, and macOS were not tested in this review. This feature slice uses `Refs #1468`; the remaining scope stays open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
